derived_quantities.description: Higher of actual (billed) weight and the 25 kg minimum chargeable weight.

accessorials_policy.clause: alpine-express.md §§1-4 (silent on charges outside the listed schedule)

invoice_adjustments.label: 5% discount on invoice total when more than 12 consignments are tendered in a calendar month
invoice_adjustments.quote: In any calendar month in which the Customer tenders more than 12 consignments, the Carrier will apply a 5% discount to the invoice total for that month's invoice.

ambiguities.description: The rate schedule prices consignments 'under 50 kg' at ₹9.50/kg and consignments 'over 50 kg' at ₹8.25/kg. Neither band covers a chargeable weight of exactly 50 kg, so the rate for that exact value is undetermined.
The agreement states express products are not offered and all bookings travel on standard service. No rate exists under this contract for a shipment recorded with service_level = express.

The contract does not explicitly state whether charges outside its rate schedule (freight and fragile handling) are payable or excluded. accessorials_policy.closed_list is recorded as false rather than assumed closed.

notes: Charges encoded: base_freight (tiered ₹9.50/kg under 50kg chargeable weight, ₹8.25/kg over 50kg, chargeable weight = max(actual, 25kg minimum) per §1-§2) and fragile_handling (flat ₹150/consignment when special_handling contains fragile, per §4). Invoice adjustment: volume_discount (-5% of invoice total when consignments_in_calendar_month > 12, per §5). services_offered restricted to [standard] per §3 (express not offered). Ambiguities: (1) exact 50kg chargeable weight falls in the gap between the 'under 50' and 'over 50' rate bands and is left undetermined; (2) no price exists for service_level=express since the contract excludes express entirely; (3) the contract never states whether accessorials outside its schedule are payable, so accessorials_policy.closed_list is set false rather than assumed.
